{{Quote|General Kenobi, you're clear to land, Docking Bay Five. Ready to proceed to Teth on your order.|''Spirit of the Republic'' Air Group Control|<ref name="SW:TCWn" />}}
The '''''Spirit of the Republic''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of [[Republic Navy/Legends|the navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ''Spirit'' served as [[Transport/Legends|transport]] for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] both to and from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for negotiations with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], and also as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==History==
{{Quote|Skywalker, we're going to drop the deflectors, but we need to lose those vultures. Divert to the aft hangar, I repeat, aft hangar. And check your transponder next time you commandeer an enemy vessel. We've had a few suicide runs before, and we shoot first.|Wullf Yularen, aboard the ''Spirit of the Republic'', to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="SW:TCWn" />}}
A [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''Spirit of the Republic'' served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a war waged between the Republic and the Separatists of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SW:TCWn" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)]]'' in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] utilized the ''Spirit'' for transportation to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] met and negotiated with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], concerning the rescue of his recently kidnapped son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]]. Upon the completion of their terse negotiations, Kenobi returned to the ''Spirit'' via [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], and ordered the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to depart for [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. There, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were attempting to rescue the missing Hutt [[Youngling/Legends|child]] from the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the CIS.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

[[File:Sky_fight_over_Teth.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Spirit of the Republic'' amidst the battle on Teth]]
Serving as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Republic [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]],<ref name="SW:TCWn" /> the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''Spirit of the Republic'' emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over Teth and moved into the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], only to be swept up in the ongoing [[Battle of Teth/Legends|battle]] being waged between Skywalker's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] under the authority of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] and Separatist [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. While Kenobi launched an attack on the ancient [[B'omarr Monastery|B'omarr monastery]] at the heart of the fighting, leading a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] from his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the ''Spirit'' engaged a Confederate [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] in the upper atmosphere. It was during this battle with the Confederate [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]] scanners aboard the ''Spirit of the Republic'' picked up an incoming CIS transponder signal, and opened [[Laser cannon/Legends|fire]] on what turned out to be General Skywalker aboard the commandeered [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] vessel, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]; after suffering a number of Separatist [[Death/Legends|suicide]] runs in the past, the ''Spirit''{{'s}} "shoot first" standard operating procedure had been solidified. However, once Skywalker managed to convince Admiral Yularen of the ''Twilight''{{'s}} true allegiances, the ''Spirit''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] were temporarily lowered in order to provide the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] access to the rear port [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay to land. Skywalker had been under fire from three pursuing [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], however, and when the ''Spirit''{{'s}} port rear hangar was opened, the three Vultures [[Ramming/Legends|rammed]] themselves into the open hangar bay. The subsequent explosion from their impact killed the [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]] overseeing the hangar, and severely damaged the bay. Skywalker was forced to take the young Huttlet he managed to rescue from the [[Monastery/Legends|monastery]] back to his [[Parent/Legends|father]] Jabba on Tatooine aboard the ''Twilight'', with only his Padawan and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] for support.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Spirit of the Republic'' first appeared in the [[2008]] adult [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]. The ship subsequently appeared, albeit unnamed, in the film itself when it debuted in theaters several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later on [[August 15]].

The ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' reference book mistakenly places the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], and not the ''Spirit of the Republic'', as the ''Venator'' cruiser present at the Battle of Teth.
